name: The Madras Biryani
description:
Authentic Chennai Biryani.

Chennai biryani is a flavorful and aromatic rice dish, distinguished by its use of basmati rice, tender marinated meat (usually chicken or mutton), and a rich blend of spices like cinnamon, cloves, and cardamom. Fresh herbs such as mint and coriander add a refreshing touch, making it a beloved specialty of the region.

featured_reviews.name: Aaron Godinho
featured_reviews.review_text:
recently visited Aurika with my family, expecting a memorable dining experience, especially since the venue was previously known as Benchmark, a place that consistently served excellent food with impeccable service. Unfortunately, this visit was a major disappointment.
We ordered beer, salted peanuts, grilled chicken and jalapeño pizza, loaded nachos with beans, salsa, sour cream and guacamole, and the Jawa Lollipop. The first issue came with the pizza. While the menu description suggested a flavourful pizza, it arrived without any noticeable sauce. Since my young daughter was hungry, we decided not to complain and ate it anyway.
Next came the loaded nachos. The menu clearly mentioned guacamole, but none was visible on the plate. Assuming it might be underneath the chips, I checked but found no sign of it. When I asked the captain, he said he would check with the kitchen. A few minutes later, he returned and casually informed me, "Guacamole nahi hai, baki sab hai." No apology, no alternative offered, and no explanation. When I asked whether that was acceptable, I received no response.
The biggest disappointment was the Jawa Lollipop. The menu described it as Thai ginger and lemongrass-coated chicken tossed in a yellow sauce. What arrived looked exactly like regular Drums of Heaven (also known as Apple Chicken) in a red sauce. Before the dish was served, I informed the captain that it did not match the menu description. He seemed unaware of the dish's own description, although the waiter immediately understood my concern.
The captain then attempted to convince me that the dish served was indeed the Jawa Lollipop. Unsatisfied, I spoke to the manager, Mr. Sujit. I explained that the dish did not resemble the menu description at all. His response was that there was a "printing mistake" in the menu and that the sauce was supposed to be red, not yellow. This explanation raised even more questions about menu accuracy and quality control.
Unfortunately, the problems didn't end there. Upon taking the first bite, the chicken had an unpleasant smell. It tasted like a poorly executed version of Drums of Heaven, with an excessive amount of vinegar seemingly added to mask the odour. I called the waiter over, and even he acknowledged that there was a smell. Mr. Sujit went into the kitchen to check, but no one returned to follow up or address the issue.
At that point, I asked for the bill. When asked if I wanted the dish packed for takeaway, I declined and requested that Mr. Sujit and the chef taste it themselves. I paid for the meal and left without eating the Jawa Lollipop.
What disappointed me most was not just the food but the complete lack of accountability. Missing ingredients, inaccurate menu descriptions, questionable food quality, and poor complaint handling turned what should have been an enjoyable family meal into a frustrating experience.
I hope Aurika takes customer feedback seriously and improves both its kitchen standards and service practices, because based on this visit, it falls far short of the standards that Benchmark once set.
I would rate this experience 1.5/5 stars. The staff was polite, but the food quality, menu accuracy, and handling of customer concerns were deeply disappointing.
featured_reviews.response_from_owner_text: Dear Aaron, thank you for taking the time to share such detailed feedback about your recent visit. We sincerely apologize that your experience did not meet your expectations, especially regarding the pizza, the missing guacamole in the loaded nachos, the concerns about the Jawa Lollipop, and the way your feedback was handled by our team. We understand how disappointing it must have been when your concerns were not addressed promptly or followed up appropriately, and we assure you that your comments regarding menu accuracy, food quality, communication, and service standards will be reviewed seriously with our kitchen and management teams. We truly value every guest who visits our premium restaurant in Vasai East, and we hope you will consider giving us another opportunity in the future to provide the quality food, attentive service, and memorable dining experience that we strive to deliver.
